name: Carpentry
overview: Scripture reveals carpentry as a skilled and purposeful craft integral to God's redemptive plan, exemplified by the detailed construction of Noah's ark with precise measurements and design (Genesis 6:14-16). The calling of Bezaleel to craft the tabernacle and its furnishings (Exodus 31:2) highlights the sacred role of craftsmanship in worship. Isaiah's depiction of the carpenter's meticulous work, from measuring and shaping wood to assembling it securely (Isaiah 41:7; 44:13), underscores the diligence and care inherent in this trade. Furthermore, the presence of carpenters in biblical narratives, including Joseph and Jesus, connects this humble craft to the lineage of the Messiah.
